svg.text: L2. Three research outposts, to scale
One screen is 3,000 units across, fighters 75 tall. A station is 6 to 9 buildings at the city scale (huts 300 tall, a lab 520, tanks 400, a mast 800).
Glasswatch: The shelf station: on the flat ice shelf (36 units above the sea): the sea is within 2,500 units on one side and the dome rises on the other
Rimewatch: The high station: on the ice sheet 1,450 units up, rock showing through nearby, nothing else for thousands of units
Thawwatch: The floe station: at the north pole, on the middle of a big floe (18 units above the water): open water more than 1,500 units away
What a polar outpost is for: something to break, and a few people to evacuate, in an arena that is otherwise empty ice.
Tens of people each (a few hundredths of a city's weight), so the collateral shares barely move.
